It was originally released in conjunction with [[The Final Act Event]] before being taken off sale in [[v2.7.0]]. This crate yields cinema-themed skins. ==Appearance== The '''Showtime Crate''' is a black-and-white wooden chest with comedy and tragedy masks at the front. It has a bowtie lock which can be opened. ==Methods of Obtaining== #Previously purchasable in the store for {{Robux|199}}. #*This could be repeated multiple times. #Had a chance of 13.39% to obtain in {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ShowtimeCrateKey.png|Key used to open the '''Showtime Crate'''. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Showtime Crate''' was released in conjunction with [[The Final Act Event]] and had a complicated history regarding its status as a permanent or limited time crate. **BelowNatural initially referred to a skin from the crate as coming from an event crate.https://x.com/BelowNatural/status/2001498780315595110 At the time of the release of the update, the Discord announcement also referred to them as event crates.https://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/664997359071002637/1451732567316365464 (Tower Defense Simulator Server) **Once the crate came out a few contributors referred to it as permanent,https://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/600908514847883294/1452015712599281917 (Tower Defense Simulator Server)https://www.reddit.com/r/TDS_Roblox/comments/1q0ln25/comment/nwz5m5i which eventually was shown to not be true by the [[v1.85.0]] update log announcing it as disappearing with [[The Final Act Event]] on the 2nd of March 2026[[v1.85.0#Official Update Log]] while the Discord announcement listed it as the 25th of February 2026.https://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/664997359071002637/1471246421503115519 (Tower Defense Simulator Server) **Once [[The Final Act Event]] event disappeared, the crate was not actually taken offsale, and few months later on the 9th of May 2026, it would also get recategorized from {{Color|Event}} to {{Color|Common|Default}} in the inventory, suggesting it was actually made permanent. **It would for once be shown it was not permanent in [[v2.7.0]] where it was suddenly taken offsale. ***Weirdly enough, the not owned skins still appear in the inventory as locked despite the crate being offsale. ==Update History== *'''20 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0]] **'''Showtime Crate''' added. **{{Bug}} Reuses [[Banned Crate]] icons that appear in [[Index#Achievements|Achievement]]s. **{{Bug}} Icon does not load on the reward screen. *'''12 January 2026''' - [[v1.83.0|v1.83.11]] **{{Bugfix}} Icon now loads on the reward screen. *'''22 April 2026''' - [[v1.89.0]] **Crate opening music added. **{{Bugfix}} No longer reuses the [[Banned Crate]] icon. *'''9 May 2026''' - [[v1.90.0]] ** Category moved from {{Color|Event}} to {{Color|Common|Default}}. *'''21 August 2026''' - [[v2.7.0]] ** '''Showtime Crate''' taken offsale. ==Notes== {{CrateNavBox}}
